about_the_game:
Backstory

Arya, an ordinary girl, travels to a mysterious other world in an accident - the "Realm of Ghostly Light". It's littered with dangerous monster lairs, and the legendary scattered shards of mysterious beads have the power to bring her back to the world she came from. To collect the shards, Arya must delve into treacherous wilderness, dark forests, and abandoned ancient cities, battling monsters in a world that alternates day and night, and uncovering the ancient secrets behind the beads......

Take on the monster lair

Each lair has a unique monster boss, and players need to develop tactics using the environment, weapons, and skills.

Defeating monster bosses will give you bead shards, which you can collect to unlock the true power of the beads and even change some of the rules of the world.

Fragments and weapons collection

Gradually uncover the truth of the Realm of Light by defeating monsters, completing quests, and exploring hidden locations.

Open world

Find tools and potions in your adventures to deal with monster attacks and challenges from the natural environment.

Interact with NPCs from other worlds, accept commissions or trade key items, and their fates may change depending on your choices.

Style & Ambience

The game adopts a 3D fantasy style, with four seasons of light and shadow changing day and night, and a variety of weather randomly appearing ......, creating a sometimes quiet and sometimes tense atmosphere. From the misty grasslands of the morning to the ruins shrouded in a blood moon, stories and dangers lurk around every corner.

Goal & Ending

Will Arya be able to collect all the shards in the end? Is it salvation or a bigger conspiracy behind the beads?

"The Queen of the Bugs" - Day and night, adventure, can you light the way home?

(Platform: PC/Console/Mobile |.) Genre: Action Adventure, Light Survival | For players who like exploration, strategic combat, and immersive storytelling)
